payload.name: Jaheira

personality.summary: A half-elf druid-warrior and Harper leader who has buried more friends than most people meet. Dry, fierce, maternal in a way that bites; she has saved the Coast before and is too tired and too stubborn to stop now. The player's likeliest mentor and door into the Harpers.

payload.role: High Harper, veteran of a hundred years
payload.want: Suspects someone is gathering the Absolute's loose ends — and that the new powers circling the dukedom are not all what they claim.
